name: neo-angband-mod-feature-restoration
description: Brings back beloved Angband features that later versions dropped, as opt-in content, for Neo Angband
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)
//private: Not published to npm, and not intended to be. A mod is distributed as a FOLDER the
game fetches - manifest.json plus its content files, at a tag, verified against a
digest that ships inside the game. npm is not in that path.
//shape: Mostly content, plus one plugin. Restoring a spell to a class's book (class.json)
is a data patch - applied or not by whether the 'teleport-other' section is on, no
Store discounts are the one restoration with no data to patch onto: 4.2.6's core
dropped the discount FIELD along with the mechanic, so plugin.ts installs a
registry:store discount roll instead, gated on the 'feature-restoration.discounts'
rule flag. See plugin.ts's own header.
//dependencies: core and content are devDependencies, never dependencies: they are here for TYPES
and for the tests, which check this mod's patches against the REAL, PUBLISHED
content pack rather than a hand-written mirror of it - the version a player runs.
The mod SDK is here only for recordKey(), which the tests use to derive each ref
from the pack's own data instead of copying it out of class.json by hand.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check

//allowScripts: npm 12 blocks a dependency postinstall unless it is named here; npm 10, which this
repo CI still runs on Node 22, just runs it. Denied rather than approved because it
was MEASURED to be unnecessary: esbuild resolves its binary through the platform
postinstall skipped. Written down so the two npm versions do not quietly disagree.
